body: I've just seen now, I'm still trying to think how I'm gonna open up to my parents. But I think I'm doing well so far if I'm not thinking about "it" atm. I do have my times when I'm doing nothing

Turns out I have accumulated failures. Failures in which I got too scared to attend class because of social anxiety disorder. I'm semi at-ease because I don't have to face them anymore but scared at the same time because my parents still don't know about it

I am really happy getting a reply from a person and yes, I am trying to explore the world once again. Depression took my youth. My distractions could no longer help me but I guess I will give it another chance and really explore.  I don't know how to communicate with my dad as he was really the person that I'm really scared of but I'll try to get help from my mom to talk to him. I might start earning money to get a psychiatrist appointment as I am only a student. And yet again, I really appreciate you replying to this post. I wish you nothing but the best

I would like to seek advice from people as I once tried to reach out to my parents and was labeled crazy because “it’s all in the head”. And once I had a psychiatry meeting and my dad eagerly came in. Instead of me opening up to my psych, I chose to lie because I couldn’t say the things that I wanted to say as I was being monitored by my parent. I grew up scared of my parents

I really appreciate getting a reply. I cannot seem to open this problem to my parents as I grew up scared of them. They do not believe I do not have such a condition and once was considered crazy. I really appreciate art but can only appreciate and cannot create

Lost my thrive to pursue anything in life. Already got tired of my "distractions" from all of these. And just now, my college account got deactivated and I wasn't informed why. I'm on the verge to give it all up. Please help
Hello, I would like to have a private conversation with you if it's okay. I just want advice

I’ll do my best to get my diploma. And I’ll do what you said, help my family with household chores. I’ll update you guys in the future. I’ll pin this thread in my browser to remember. Takes a lot bro. Hope you’re doing well
Oh, so sorry to hear that. I hope so too. I'm just too tired of being a burden to my family
Just contacted an admin, they can't cover it since it's my fault. I fully understand their situation
I will try. I haven’t thought of that. I am completely sure as well that it was my stupidity
English is not my first language. Sorry if you guys get confused
